unavailable: Clipboard access is unavailable. Use the browser’s Copy or Paste command while the canvas is focused.
readFailed: The clipboard could not be read. Allow clipboard access or use your browser’s Paste command.
writeFailed: The selection could not be copied to the clipboard.
invalid: This clipboard content is not a supported {{brandName}} document.
missingImages: The original images are unavailable in this project. Copy again with Include images enabled in General settings.
tooLarge: This selection exceeds the 32 MiB clipboard limit. Copy fewer items or exclude images in General settings.
stale: The composition changed while reading the clipboard. Paste again.
empty: Select at least one item to copy, or use Copy composition.
